ANOMALY_LOG (auto-detected):
- cluster-gamma.train: sustained p95 >= 98% for last 6 hours (2024-11-04 15:00-21:00) coinciding with 5x increase in short training jobs (mean_seq_len up 2.8x). Potential queuing/backpressure.
- cluster-alpha.train: preemption spikes (3 events) between 02:00-04:00 UTC; matches scheduled backfill window testing by SE team (ticket INFRA-2812).

QUICK SUMMARY / INTERPRETATION:
- US-WEST (cluster-alpha) is operating near capacity for training workloads (avg 82%, p95 97%) but has headroom in infer pools; consider rebalancing small batch infer workloads to free train capacity during peak hours.
- EU region (cluster-gamma) shows highest sustained tail utilization and occasional OOM-related job failures (see linked Grafana: panel 'OOM-events-by-cluster'). This is our highest risk in next 72h if incoming enterprise training requests hit schedule.
- US-EAST (cluster-beta) current allocations look comfortable but trending up week-over-week; monitor job mix.

RECOMMENDATIONS / ACTION ITEMS:
- [Action-1] (Owner: Miguel Alvarez) Create short-term autoscale headroom policy for cluster-alpha.train: add 32 GPUs from burst pool or shift low-priority training to reserved low-cost nodes during 14:00-22:00 PST peak window. Due: 2024-11-07.
- [Action-2] (Owner: Renee Chen) Investigate OOMs on cluster-gamma.train, collect failing job ids, and run unit repros in staging. File follow-up with Applied ML if model memory spike confirmed. Due: 2024-11-06.
- [Action-3] (Owner: Samir Gupta) Evaluate short-term quota bump for eu-central reserved capacity (proposal draft linked INFRA-2789). Due: 2024-11-08.
- [Action-4] (Owner: Aisha Patel) Add a Grafana alert for p95_gpu_util >= 96% for >=30m per cluster-pool with notification to #infra-gpu-ops and paging rules set to on-call SRE. Done: draft, needs review.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS / NOTES:
- Export only includes V100/A100 pools; recently added L4 pools are not yet in the dashboard because metrics pipeline filter needs a schema update (PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/441).
- Mean sequence length is an approximate proxy for memory footprint; models with long context windows may skew util per token metrics.

ATTACHMENTS / REFERENCES:
- Raw CSV snapshot attached to this doc in Drive (file: raw/cluster-pool-daily-2024-11-04.csv)
- Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/gpu-utilization-overview
- Incident ticket (OOMs): https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INFRA-2812

NOTES TO SELF (workboard):
- Follow up on training job preemption policy: does canary on preemptible pools need extension?
- Check with Solutions Eng whether upcoming customer ramp (ACME) schedules large infer jobs in us-west on 2024-11-12 - could require capacity reservation.
